product.title: Mt Fuji & Hakone Private Day Tour w/ English Speaking Driver

description.text: In Tokyo, this private 10-hour charter pairs an English-speaking driver with a published Mount Fuji and Hakone stop list from central hotels. Weather permitting, the route can include the Fifth Station, Owakudani Valley, the Hakone Ropeway, Lake Ashinoko, Hakone Shrine, and Oishi Park. Fuel, tolls, and the vehicle are included; meals and some admissions stay separate. The published window is 10 hours from Tokyo pickup to drop-off, with overtime listed at 2,500 yen per 30 minutes. The format suits visitors who want a guided Fuji-Hakone day without assembling ropeway and lake timing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Tokyo, and the itinerary stays on the Fifth Station, Owakudani, and Lake Ashinoko that define this charter rather than a Nikko shrine day.
